ChannelConnectionConfiguration.description:
Non-secret Runtime configuration for one external channel account.

``principal_scope`` is the Runtime-owned privacy, relationship, and memory
isolation key. It is not a provider user id and must never be derived from
message text. Provider credentials and login state are intentionally absent.

account_key.description: Opaque provider-scoped account identity; never a credential
account_key.title: Account Key

allowed_sender_keys.description: Opaque provider-scoped sender identities admitted by this connection; an empty list admits no senders
allowed_sender_keys.title: Allowed Sender Keys

presentation_policy.description: Optional presentation and cadence policy override for this connection

principal_scope.description: Runtime-owned stable isolation key for persona relationship and memory state; it is not a provider identity and must match the configured connection
principal_scope.title: Principal Scope

timeout_seconds.description: Recent authenticated adapter activity window used by local health presentation; it is not a generation or provider-delivery deadline
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

ChannelPresentationPolicy.description: Provider-neutral cadence and bubble planning rules for channel outbound deliveries.

bypass_long_form.description: Whether technical, code, or structured responses bypass bubble splitting into a single part
bypass_long_form.title: Bypass Long Form

cadence_enabled.description: Whether inter-part delivery delay is computed and scheduled
cadence_enabled.title: Cadence Enabled

max_delay_ms.description: Upper clamp bound for inter-part delay in milliseconds
max_delay_ms.title: Max Delay Ms

max_parts.description: Maximum delivery parts (bubbles) planned for ordinary casual turns
max_parts.title: Max Parts

min_delay_ms.description: Lower clamp bound for inter-part delay in milliseconds
min_delay_ms.title: Min Delay Ms

preferred_chars_per_part.description: Preferred character count per bubble when segmenting sentences
preferred_chars_per_part.title: Preferred Chars Per Part

soft_max_chars_per_part.description: Soft upper character bound before splitting weaker sentence boundaries
soft_max_chars_per_part.title: Soft Max Chars Per Part

total_cadence_delay_ceiling_ms.description: Maximum cumulative delay across all parts of a single delivery plan
total_cadence_delay_ceiling_ms.title: Total Cadence Delay Ceiling Ms

typing_enabled.description: Whether typing indicators are emitted (reserved for Phase 17.1B-2)
typing_enabled.title: Typing Enabled

ChannelProviderCapabilities.description:
Transport behavior advertised by one provider adapter.

The first provider advertises only direct text by default. ``group`` is a
protocol capability for future adapters, but a Runtime must reject it until
its provider registration and local policy explicitly enable group chat.

authorization_methods.description: Interactive authorization methods implemented by the local adapter; an empty list means connection provisioning is external
authorization_methods.title: Authorization Methods

description:
Persisted connection state safe to expose to local settings clients.

``account_key`` and ``allowed_sender_keys`` remain local, non-secret,
provider-scoped identifiers. They are never credentials and should not be
forwarded to a conversation peer.
title: ChannelConnectionSnapshot
